method: Run each case with the skill and without it (same model, same prompt), 3 runs each. The skill is justified only if it beats the baseline consistently. Record time and output tokens too.

evals.prompt: Review this before I open the PR.
expectations: Leads with correctness: the mutable default `seen=[]`, the file opened without `with`, and `assert path` used to validate input
Flags `except Exception: pass` in refresh() as swallowing errors and proposes a narrow catch or logger.exception
Rewrites the f-string logging call as a lazy pattern: logger.info("loaded %d rows from %s", ...)
Flags `name: str = None` as an implicit Optional
Uses the [severity] path:LINE format from SKILL.md and ends with a list of checks not run
Does not claim ruff or mypy ran unless it actually ran scripts/check.py
Reports no high or medium findings
Does not invent problems to fill the review; at most optional low-severity notes, clearly marked optional

evals.prompt: Write a function in this project that parses an ISO date string or returns None.
expectations: Uses Optional[...] / typing syntax compatible with requires-python = ">=3.8" (no `X | None` in runtime annotations, no `match`)
Annotates the public function and documents the None case
